map.估算触发保费豁免后，可免除的未来保费总额与净收益: Estimate the total waived future premium and net benefit once premium waiver is triggered.
map.📖 查看「保费豁免计算 使用指南」: 📖 View the "Premium Waiver Calculation User Guide"
map.豁免保费现值 = Σ 未缴保费_t/(1+i)^t: PV of waived premium = Σ unpaid premium_t/(1+i)^t
map.豁免保费总额 = 年缴保费 × 剩余缴费年数: Total waived premium = annual premium × remaining paying years
map.净收益 = 豁免保费总额 - 豁免附加险累计成本（如已购买）: Net benefit = total waived premium − cumulative waiver-rider cost (if purchased)
map.本工具按静态金额计算，未考虑保费的时间价值与投资收益: This tool uses static amounts and ignores the time value of premiums and investment returns.
map.是否触发豁免以保险合同条款及保险公司核赔结论为准: Whether waiver triggers is governed by the policy terms and the insurer's claims decision.
map.📚 深度解析：保费豁免现值计算: 📚 Deep Dive: Premium Waiver Present Value
map.投保人身故/失能后剩余保费免缴，算免缴保费的现值用于责任准备金。: After the insured's death/disability, remaining premiums are waived; compute the PV of waived premiums for the reserve.
map.对比不同剩余年限下豁免现值的差异。: Compare waiver PVs across different remaining terms.
map.已缴年数影响什么？: What does years already paid affect?
map.只对未来未缴年贴现。已缴部分不再产生现金流，剩余年限越短豁免现值越小。: Only future unpaid years are discounted. Paid portions generate no more cash flow; the shorter the remaining term, the smaller the waiver PV.
map.豁免现价和现金价值是一回事吗？: Is waiver PV the same as cash value?
map.不是。豁免现值是未来免缴保费的现值，归公司责任；现金价值是保单持有人的退保利益，: No. Waiver PV is the present value of future waived premiums, a company liability; cash value is the policyholder's surrender benefit, in a different account — they are not additive.
